name: Promiscuity
overview: Scripture warns believers to guard their hearts against lust and the enticements of promiscuity, emphasizing that even looking with lust is equivalent to committing adultery in the heart. Proverbs cautions against being captivated by the allure of the 'strange woman' who flatters with her words, while Romans exhorts Christians to live honorably, avoiding immoral behaviors such as wantonness and licentiousness. Jesus teaches that offenses related to sin will occur, but those who cause others to stumble bear a grave responsibility, underscoring the seriousness of purity in thought and conduct.
